south-pacific-division-2021.notes: Source 2 is an image-only PDF read by OCR; team count approximate. Standings (93 rows) and the site report (86 teams) differ in count.

sources.evidence: The seed page of the South Pacific Programming Contests site gives the 2021 schedule (Divisional Finals October 16th, Regional Finals December 11th) and the site holds a 2021 results page for this contest.
A 3-page PDF printed from DOMjudge, headed ICPC 2021 South Pacific Divisional Finals preliminary results - not final, with columns A to M, read by OCR; its last-update line reads Sat 16 Oct 2021.
A table of 93 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and Site citation, headed The 2021 South Pacific Independent Regional Contest Divisional.
